title: Hard to Do
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 1.17 Linked Discourses 1.17
  • 2. Nandanavagga 2. The Garden of Delight

Dukkarasutta Hard to Do

“Dukkaraṁ duttitikkhañca, “Hard to do, hard to endure, abyattena ca sāmaññaṁ; is the ascetic life for the inept, Bahūhi tattha sambādhā, for it has many narrow passes yattha bālo visīdatī”ti. where the fool founders.”

“Katihaṁ careyya sāmaññaṁ, “How many days could an ascetic live cittañce na nivāraye; without controlling the mind? Pade pade visīdeyya, They’d founder with each step, saṅkappānaṁ vasānugoti. under the sway of thoughts.

Kummova aṅgāni sake kapāle, A mendicant should collect their thoughts Samodahaṁ bhikkhu manovitakke; as a tortoise draws its limbs into its shell. Anissito aññamaheṭhayāno, Independent, not disturbing others, Parinibbuto nūpavadeyya kañcī”ti. quenched: they wouldn’t blame anyone.”
